description: Update the content of an acceptance criterion (Given/When/Then, description, scenario category). This tool does not change status. To work on a criterion use vibemap_claim_criterion (or vibemap_claim_story), then vibemap_report_progress, then vibemap_submit_for_review when your code satisfies it; CI or a human reviewer decides whether it passes. For spec authoring only: while building a ticket, use vibemap_propose_spec_change instead, so a person reviews the change.
name: vibemap_update_acceptance_criterion
